name: Escape Tung Tung For Brainrots!
desc:
Welcome to Escape Tung Tung For Brainrots! 

What’s New:
🍬 25 brand-new Candy Mutations added
🧠 8 new Brainrots introduced to collect
🔒 Secret Admin Event added (👀)
🌊 New wave types for more varied gameplay
🌪️ Super Wind obstacle added to increase difficulty
👋 New Slap Tool introduced
🛡️ ForceField added

Run when it’s GREEN and stop when it’s RED! 🏃🛑
Grab Brainrots and bring them to safety! 🧠
Don’t let the giant see you move! 👁️
Stay in the game and save more Brainrots! ⚡
Upgrade your Brainrots to earn more money! 💸
Upgrade your base to unlock more slots and hold even more Brainrots! 🏗️

Your Brainrots earn cash while you’re away! 💤

Like the game and join the group for an epic Brainrot! 👍🔥
